answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the ripple until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the shale of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
